title: High-Pressure Ceiling / Effect-Target Diagnostic
purpose: Determine whether R72 G9 failed because F05 has no high-pressure allocation value, or because the preregistered forced-compression/overload target had a ceiling/no-headroom and wrong-direction problem. Diagnose the effect target without changing the R72 verdict.
research_questions: Among fresh high-pressure exact-R69 Control cases, how often is the old R72 G9 forced-compression/overload target greater than zero?
Among the same fresh high-pressure Controls, how often is there measurable economy/fragmentation headroom despite old-G9 headroom being zero?
On fresh high-pressure cases with preregistered Control-only economy headroom, does the unchanged F05 Treatment reduce economy/fragmentation violations while preserving all required causal work?

hypotheses.H1_ceiling_replication: Old-G9 forced-compression/overload headroom is present in no more than 25% of fresh high-pressure exact-R69 Controls.
hypotheses.H2_alternative_headroom: At least 50% of fresh high-pressure exact-R69 Controls have economy/fragmentation headroom (control_economy_violations >= 1).
hypotheses.H3_treatment_signal: If Stage B is eligible, unchanged F05 Treatment reduces economy/fragmentation violations versus exact R69 in at least 18/24 fresh high-pressure headroom cases, with no critical safety loss.
hypotheses.H4_no_compression_regression: Treatment is never worse than Control on the old forced-compression/overload count in any Stage-B case.

source_and_fresh_case_rule.source: DB64 R127 independently verified consumer_ready_r53 corpus
source_and_fresh_case_rule.source_cutoff: Use only cutoff-safe planner_input, thick_sequence, authored_arc, and runtime_safe thread_state artifacts already available in DB64 R127.
source_and_fresh_case_rule.exclude_cases: Every case used as a primary case in R72 R2, R3, R4, or R5.
source_and_fresh_case_rule.runtime_input_validity: Candidate case must successfully pass exact R69 compile_active_obligation_portfolio using the frozen DB64-derived explicit episode input. Only pass/fail is used before pressure stratification.
source_and_fresh_case_rule.pressure_stratum: Sort all fresh eligible cases by the unchanged R72 total-pressure ontology and split into equal tertiles; only the HIGH tertile enters R73 Stage A.

stage_a_control_only_census.control: Exact R69 adaptive_showrunner_ul16.compile_adaptive_architecture on every fresh HIGH case.
stage_a_control_only_census.old_g9_headroom_definition: control_forced_compression_overload_violations > 0, using the unchanged R72 bridge metric.
stage_a_control_only_census.economy_headroom_definition: control_economy_violations >= 1, where economy violations are unchanged R72 sum of allocation duplicate count + empty/unnecessary allocation scenes + F04 semantic repetition groups + F06 redundant_or_mergeable count.

stage_a_gates.A3_stage_b_availability: at least 24 economy-headroom HIGH cases across at least 12 distinct works after all exclusions

stage_b_treatment_test.eligibility: Run only if A3 passes. Selection is from fresh HIGH cases with control_economy_violations >= 1.
stage_b_treatment_test.selection: Deterministically rank eligible cases by SHA256(preregistration_sha256|work|episode_no), enforce max 2 cases/work, select first 24, require >=12 works, then seal the ledger before any Treatment output.
stage_b_treatment_test.control: The already sealed exact-R69 Control result from Stage A; do not rerun or replace for scoring unless a documented infrastructure corruption is proven.
stage_b_treatment_test.treatment: Exact unchanged R72 F05 Adaptive Pressure Allocator R2; no allocator tuning, no threshold tuning, no non-F05 module changes.

gates.B6_economy_effect: Treatment economy violations < Control in at least 18/24 cases
gates.B7_economy_nonworsening: Treatment economy violations <= Control in at least 23/24 cases
gates.B8_old_g9_nonregression: Treatment forced-compression/overload violations <= Control in 24/24 cases

stage_b_treatment_test.scene_count_rule: Raw scene-count reduction or expansion is descriptive only and cannot by itself satisfy any efficacy gate. Fewer scenes are not automatically better.

prohibited_changes: Do not change R72 verdict, G9 definition, or thresholds.
Do not use any R72 primary case in R73.
Do not inspect R73 Treatment outputs before the Stage-B ledger is sealed.
Do not modify F01, F02, F04, F06, F07, retrieval, renderer, DB authority, or exact-R69 Control behavior.
Do not tune the F05 allocator in R73; R73 tests target/ceiling diagnosis with the unchanged allocator.
Do not promote Production, restore Level-3, or claim F05 qualification from R73 alone.
claim_boundary: Diagnostic evidence at the planning/allocation layer only. R73 can establish whether R72's high-pressure metric had ceiling/direction mismatch and whether an unchanged F05 allocator has fresh high-pressure economy signal. It cannot retroactively pass R72, qualify F05 for Production, restore operational Level-3, or validate screenplay surface quality.
